author: ViceTechnicolour
body:
Over the past few months (or many, actually) there have been several complaints or urges for us to move back and stay with how the current server was, back 9 months ago or possibly beyond all the way to MCZone. As we go along, we need to lose the grip of our past, and climb up to the future. We need to not hang on so long to something, and instead try to adjust ourselves to change: What you may dislike, another may like. It's hard to truly please everyone and as we go along, the server has to expand or follow up with changes. Think of all these updates as the nostalgia of the future. 

Other than all this, Avicus tries to do their best to give the server an amazing experience for everyone, and we try to follow community feedback which most servers do not. Avicus tries to find a balance, and tries to do everything in our power to have a happy community. Updating the server is not in regards to malicious intentions to make you all mad: And it's certainly not about the money. It's ran for us to have a good time, because Ivy and himself in all his power and knowledge could probably land a job with a 10 times better pay, and without all the stress. After talking to him so much, he really is a friendly person and is connected more than you think. Same with pavilion, he hooked in and wants to help improve the server. Not make it worse.

We can't become so hooked in the past because change is a thing. Change is common. Change is good. Change is bad. Change is different. Change is everything. You can't simply glue your eyes to a screen and expect everything to go your way; opinions are welcome, and everyone works together as a family to provide you with the best Minecraft PvP server, and beyond that an amazing community. We are very close and you should be happy to see what the future holds for you in this server. Count your blessings, not your negatives.

One thing I'd like to say; So many things have come out of change. We have a great map development team to make things efficient and even more community oriented, which MCZone and Avicus didn't have complete in place: We have an amazing team of staff to guide us through and clean up the servers, moderating and helping in their best interest whether one has joined us, or one has left: We should appreciate all these changes. We have a clean, 10 times better and original website which Avicus and MCZone didn't have in place. As said, count your blessings, not your negatives. It's fine to think about the past, but you're not entitled to have it your way. It's not Burger King. It's Avicus. It's Avicore.

And change comes. Even soon.
